descriptionChirho: In the Nifal stem, to be terrified, alarmed, dismayed, or deeply troubled, expressing emotional distress or fear.
In the Nifal stem, to be hasty or to hurry, describing impetuous or rushed action rather than fear.
In the Piel stem, to terrify, frighten, or alarm another person, serving as the causative counterpart of the Nifal terror sense.
In the Piel stem, to hasten or hurry someone along, serving as the causative counterpart of the Nifal haste sense.
In the Pual (passive) stem, describing something or someone that has been hastened or gotten in haste.
In the Hifil stem, to cause someone to hurry or to rush someone out, an intensive causative of the haste meaning.
